requirements.R_TENANT_EP: Create tenant and endpoint with quota and hmac_secret.
requirements.R_ENQUEUE: Enqueue pending events; idempotency returns existing; disabled rejects; payload must be object.
requirements.R_LIST_GET: List/get events and stats shape with by_status/tenants/endpoints.
requirements.R_CLAIM: Claim sets lease; foreign active lease 409; same owner renew ok; expired lease reclaimable; disabled claim 409.
requirements.R_PAUSE: Paused endpoints reject claims; resume restores claims and writes resume audit.
requirements.R_COMPLETE: Only lease holder may complete or deliver (lease_mismatch).
requirements.R_SIGN: Delivery HMAC uses id\ntimestamp\nbody; Content-Type application/json; compact sorted-key body.
requirements.R_DLQ: Backoff schedule 5 then 15+; exhausted attempts enter dlq; deliver.fail audited.
requirements.R_QUOTA: Quota counts successful deliveries only; blocks enqueue and deliver/complete-delivered when exceeded.
requirements.R_AUDIT: Audit records enqueue (with endpoint_id), claim, deliver.ok, deliver.fail, dlq, pause, resume, replay.
requirements.R_REPLAY: Replay requires bearer when OUTBOX_TOKEN set; pending with unchanged attempt_count and cleared lease.
requirements.R_UI: UI claim posts lease_owner/lease_seconds; API errors write #error-box textContent.
requirements.R_CLI: outboxctl health, enqueue, claim, deliver, and pause against OUTBOX_ADDR.
requirements.R_SEED: Image-seeded default DB plus seed tooling remain under /app/outbox with non-empty catalog.
requirements.R_PRESERVE: Health, schema, UI index, 404 not_found, validation, tenant list, enqueue audit detail preserved.
